text: The Line 6 of the Kunming Metro (Chinese: 昆明轨道交通6号线; pinyin: Kūnmíng Guǐdào Jiāotōng Liù Hào Xiàn), also known as the Airport line (Chinese: 机场线; pinyin: Jīchǎng Xiàn), is a rapid transit line that connects Kunming Changshui International Airport with Kunming's urban center. The line is 25.3 kilometres (15.7 mi) long and has 8 stations. It entered operation on 28 June 2012, initially serving two stations: East Coach Station and Kunming Airport, coinciding with the opening of the new airport to transport passengers to downtown Kunming. The line ceased operation temporarily starting in May 2016 to facilitate preparations for the opening of Line 3, which was scheduled for early 2017. It reopened in August 2017 alongside Line 3. On subway maps, Line 6 is represented in teal. The one-way fare is CN¥5. Service operates daily from 6:00 AM to 22:00 PM, with an average headway of 15 minutes. Trains on Line 6 travel at speeds of up to 100 kilometres per hour (62 mph), and during its initial operation, a one-way trip took approximately 20 minutes. The line runs through Panlong District and Guandu District. Construction began on 1 August 2010, with track-laying completed around December 2011.
